ZiwaChain Verification

v1.0
Checked in your browser. No ZiwaClear server was contacted.
What these checks prove: that every record in this certificate existed at the specified time, that no field was altered afterwards, and that the smart contract rules (mass balance, separation of duties, role authorization) were strictly enforced on-chain.

What they do not prove: that the physical real-world facts (such as the exact scale weight at the beach) were true. That real-world link relies on independent physical verification, the buyer's wallet acceptance, and the harvester's SMS confirmation.
